Hi Emma — thanks for the clear list, and please thank your infra team for the usage estimate. I pulled together a short scenario set (attached) and a suggested concession path if you want to move forward with a Dedicated commit. High level answers below, and I'll follow up with Vanessa and Karthik to propose concrete numbers for procurement.

Retention
- Tiered storage: 0-90d (hot), 91-365d (nearline), >365d (archive). We bill tokens for active queries against retained traces/data; archive restores are charged per-GB restored + a small per-query token surcharge.
- For customers who prefer predictability we can offer a blended retention slab for a 12-month commit (reduces per-GB equivalent by ~22%).

Tracing ingest / burst policy
- We have two controls: reserved ingest capacity (guaranteed) and burst buffer (shared across region). Burst buffer is free up to 15% of reserved for short windows, beyond that it falls back to pay-as-you-go trace units. For predictable spikes we recommend a short-term uplift (week-level) that we can pre-authorize and cap on your account to avoid surprises.

Dashboards / seats
- We can convert seat licensing to a usage-credit model for contractors (monthly rolling credits). That would keep invoicing usage-based but cap monthly credits to approximate historical peak seats.

I'll attach a mock invoice and a proposed concession (one-time onboarding credit + 6% discount on observability addons for the first 6 months with a 12-month Dedicated commit). Vanessa — can you validate if engineering can extend the burst buffer to 25% for this account as a special case? Karthik — I'll need modeled numbers to present to procurement.

Best,
Sofia
